verdict.rationale: The settings docs describe a Telemetry toggle that can enable or disable sharing interaction logs to improve models, so an opt-out exists. That toggle is scoped to model-improvement interaction logs, and nothing shows it covers broader usage analytics or tracking. missing for 10: evidence that general usage/analytics tracking can be disabled, detail on what the toggle actually stops collecting, enterprise or policy-level telemetry controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
